title: 有视觉基线时记录图片必须绑定物理长板输出单元
prompt: 当前 run 已有线上截图 visual_baseline，但 prototype-board 输出单元缺少 physical_longboard。

required_behaviors: pmw-prototype-board image 读取当前 visual_baseline
缺 canvas_mode=physical_longboard 时返回非零
禁止作为交付结果展示
forbidden_behaviors: 有视觉基线但未审计就通过图片
只依赖 readiness 口头阻断
把缺少物理长板字段的图片标成已生成

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp/home"; export PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=baseline-mode-test; mkdir -p "$PMW_HOME/projects/baseline-mode-test"; python3 - "$tmp/ref.png" 1179 2556 "$tmp/img.png" 1206 2615 <<'PY'
import struct, sys, zlib
args=sys.argv[1:]
def png(path,w,h):
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+b'\xff\xff\xff' * w for _ in range(h))
    def chunk(t,d):
        return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    data=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,1))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
png(args[0],int(args[1]),int(args[2])); png(args[3],int(args[4]),int(args[5]))
PY
bin/pmw-image-audit baseline --reference "$tmp/ref.png" --target-width 1206 --target-height 2615 --register >/dev/null; bin/pmw-prototype-board add --scheme 方案A --screen 首屏 --brief-version v1 --canvas-mode standard_first_screen --target-output-pixels 'iPhone 17 402 x 874' >/dev/null; set +e; bin/pmw-prototype-board image --scheme 方案A --screen 首屏 --image "$tmp/img.png"; code=$?; cat "$PMW_HOME/projects/baseline-mode-test/prototype-board.jsonl"; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $code
